name: coordinator-amortized-flush
body: The coordinator amortizes DB work across the session: one open/parse serves N mutations. Amortization is of the DB open, NOT of visibility: each mutation's exact projection delta is applied synchronously through the write-through projection as the mutation completes, so there is no batched flush at `apg session end` and no mutation is ever invisible pending a flush. Acceptance: an N-mutation session performs materially fewer DB opens than the current per-mutation path while every mutation is visible to a new reader (a separate `apg query` process) as soon as it returns, and the DB matches a fresh re-ingest of the durable layers tree.
